questions.q_en: A can contains a mixture of two liquids P & Q in the ratio 5:3. When 16 ml of mixture are drawn off and the can is filled with same quantity of liquid Q, the ratio of P & Q becomes 23:17. How many millilitres of liquid P was contained by the can initially?
questions.solution_en:
Let the can contains 5x and 3x of mixtures P and Q.

Quantities of P in mixture left = [5x-(5/8 X 16)] = 5x - 10

Quantities of Q in mixture left = [3x-(3/8 X 16)] = 3x - 6

\ (5x - 10) / [ ( 3x - 6) +16] = 23/17

(5x - 10) / ( 3x + 10) = 23/17

85x - 170 = 69x + 230

16x = 400

x = 25

So, the can contains 25 X 5 = 125 ml of P

Part filled by P and Q together = 60/12 = 5 units/day

questions.q_en: Three partners P, Q and R invested a total of Rs. 52,000 in a business. At the end of the year, P got Rs.1430, Q got Rs.1870 and R got Rs. 2420 as the share of profit. How much amount did Q invest in the business?
questions.solution_en:
Since the period of investment is same, which mean ratio of profit from the business will be same as the ratio of their investment.

Ratio of investment of P, Q, and R = 1430: 1870: 2420 = 13: 17: 22

Investment of Q = 52000 * (17/52) = ₹17000

questions.q_en: A and B agree to share ₹5,040 in the ratio of work done. A can do a job in 8 days and B in 12 days. They work together for 3 days, then A leaves, and B completes the remaining job alone. What is A's share of the payment?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total work be LCM (8, 12) = 24 units.

Efficiency of A = 24 / 8 = 3 units/day.

Efficiency of B = 24 / 12 = 2 units/day.

A worked for 3 days.

Total work done by A = 3 units/day X 3 days = 9 units.

B worked for 3 days with A and then finished alone.

Total work done by B = 24 - 9 = 15 units.

Ratio of work done (A : B) = 9 : 15 = 3 : 5.

Sum of ratio parts = 3 + 5 = 8.

A's share = (3/8) X 5,040 = 3 X 630 = ₹1,890.

Therefore,

16 * X = 18 * Y

8X = 9Y

X = 9Y/8

X > Y.

questions.q_en: Pipe P, Q and R can fill a tank in 12 minutes, 24 minutes and 96 minutes respectively. Find the time taken to fill the tank when pipes are opened alternately for 1 minutes each starting from P.
questions.solution_en:
Capacity of tank = LCM of 12, 24 and 96 = 96 unit

Efficiency of pipe P = 96/12 = 8 unit/minute

Efficiency of pipe Q = 96/24 = 4 unit/minutes

Efficiency of pipe R = 96/96 = 1 unit/minute

Part of tank filled in first 3 minutes = 8 + 4 + 1 = 13 unit

Part of tank filled in 21 minutes = 91 unit

Remaining unit = 96 - 91 = 5 unit

Time taken to fill the remaining tank = 5/8

Total time = 21 (5/8) or 173/8 minutes

If √13 sin θ = 2, then the value of (3 tan θ + √13 sin θ) ÷ (√13 cos θ − 3 tan θ) is:
questions.solution_en:
• From √13 sin θ = 2, we get sin θ = 2/√13.

• Assuming θ is in the first quadrant, cos θ = 3/√13, so tan θ = (2/√13) ÷ (3/√13) = 2/3.

• Numerator = 3 tan θ + √13 sin θ = 3 X (2/3) + √13 X (2/√13) = 2 + 2 = 4.

• Denominator = √13 cos θ − 3 tan θ = √13 X (3/√13) − 3 X (2/3) = 3 − 2 = 1.

• Hence the value of the given expression = 4 ÷ 1 = 4.

questions.q_en: In what time does an amount becomes 2.5 times of itself at simple interest with rate of 10% per annum?

Let principal amount = P

Interest in t years = 2.5P - P = 1.5P

1.5P = P*10*t/100

t = 15 years

questions.q_en: Average runs scored by a batsman in 12 innings is 11. If he scores 89 runs in the next innings, then his average runs after 13th innings becomes -
questions.solution_en:
Average runs scored = (total runs scored)/(total no. of innings)

Total runs scored in 12 innings = 12 * 11 = 132

Total runs scored in 13 innings = 132 + 89 = 221

Therefore, average runs scored in 13 innings = 221/13 = 17
